## Change

Describe the user-visible problem and resulting behavior. Keep this pull request focused on one feature or a closely related change.

## Validation

- [ ] `pnpm typecheck`
- [ ] `pnpm test`
- [ ] `pnpm build`

Include relevant manual checks and a preview link or screenshots for UI changes. Note any checks that could not run.

## Deployment and data

List required environment variables or migrations, if any, and explain how existing data and rollback are affected. Leave this section brief when no operational change is needed.
